notes: Update source moved to GoPreach-ISO-Final. Install this version to keep receiving updates.
REQUIRED UPDATE. GoPreach is moving to a new server. Install this version to keep using GoPreach. Also: Firebase removed, Received Reports, mandatory update screen.

v1.137.0: notification sounds fixed (they now ring while the app is minimized, no replay of old items after sign-in, and the Circuit Overseer hears new Field Service Reports). Received Reports with unread notifications, Firebase fully removed, and a Hostinger server label above Sync to Server.

v1.138.0: an About icon in every account's header says which server this version uses (Hostinger), plus the notification sound fixes, Received Reports and the full move off Firebase from earlier versions.

GoPreach v1.139.0: Circuit Attendance Report snapshots (send, receive, return, lock), simpler Send to Circuit Overseer, My Submitted Reports with attendance, Manual Field Service Record status for previous months, fixes for undone months. Requires the updated backend (rules for the new attendance collections).

GoPreach v1.139.1: fixes the app closing right after login (background sync crash in the release build) and removes the My Total Hours tile from the publisher Input group. Requires the updated backend for the attendance features.

GoPreach v1.140.0: Territory Map Driving Mode (GPS-course arrow, map follow, Recenter, heading-up/north-up, GPS status, Silent/Voice switch); in-app turn-by-turn navigation with spoken guidance and rerouting; coordinates, Street View and Open in Maps on Searching / Return Visit / Bible Study records; Weather module with dashboard weather line; comparative-report and attendance improvements; fix: rotating the phone no longer restarts the app or repeats the login message.
GoPreach v1.141.0: voice notes, narration, circuit attendance comparison, glass UI, PAGASA alerts
Territory drawings are always drawn at 50% opacity.
Offline maps: choose or download the Philippines offline map file and use offline map styles and place lookup without a connection.

GoPreach v1.144.0: Field Service Group quick access and members, Publisher records (grouped, all details, print/PDF/Excel), uniform table design, Field Service Report grouping and Send to CO preview, simpler All Territories list, Territory Map with one control bar and visible map styles.
GoPreach v1.146.0: fixes the blank Admin dashboard and missing Territory Assignments after an update

GoPreach v1.147.0: Admin and publisher screen updates, Territory Map and turn-by-turn improvements, Account Management actions (change username, temporary password), Record area filter, backend account rules.

GoPreach v1.148.0: Circuit Overseer File Manager and the new Previous Manual Record (open an Excel file as it looks, save it to a congregation, search inside it), optional FS Group when enrolling or editing a publisher, and the add icon of Searching / Return Visit / Bible Study moved to the upper left under the Ministry tab.
GoPreach v1.149.0: the add icon for Searching, Return Visit and Bible Study is now at the upper left of every list (Ministry tab, the stand-alone lists and the Publisher Assignment lists).
GoPreach v1.150.0: the Circuit Overseer has a Home icon in the tab strip to go back to the main form from any module.
Territory Map opens clean: Filters, Hide Icons, Style and Drive only. Long-press shows map tools (Recenter, Nearest, Farthest, Filters, Full screen, GPS status) with the existing buttons.

Live updates across devices: lists and the map refresh by themselves when another device changes a record, and a record deleted elsewhere stays deleted. Ministerial Servant gets the Territory Map in Quick Access. Previous Manual Record sheet zooms with two fingers and has Fit.

Quick Access now has the 12 modules (Territory Map, Weather, Field Service Report, Publisher Account, My Assignment, Householder Visit History, Meeting and Cart Assignment, Publisher Schedule, Find Location, Announcement, Publisher Assignment, Field Service Group), each only for the roles that already have the module. My Assignment and Publisher Schedule now also work for admins and elders in their own congregation.

Walking Mode on the Territory Map with the same features as Driving (walking person marker, pedestrian routes). Ministerial Servant Quick Access now shows Weather, My Assignment, Meeting and Cart Assignment (view only), Publisher Schedule and Announcement. Comparative Report: full-screen viewer with compact icons and listen controls, tables with a fixed heading row.

Search Barangay in the Territory Map (the barangay you open returns to the same search results when closed). FS Group chat: the Overseer, Servant and Assistant of a group manage that group's chat and its participants, for their own group only. A Ministerial Servant in a group role sees and edits their group's Field Service Report. Walking and Driving estimates (duration and ETA) in the route preview, walking from pedestrian routes. Territory Map Walking Mode, Ministerial Servant Quick Access, and the Comparative Report full-screen viewer.
Super Admin: CO File Management, account management for Circuit Overseers and all accounts, no-readable password resets, FS Group drawing message

Summary: comparative report from your Excel records (periods, visits, congregations, saved files) with a Voice button; Territory Map rights follow the assigned Coordinator Elder, Secretary or Service Overseer role; Home button in every Circuit Overseer module; Publisher Record: username, classification, status and temporary sign-in now live inside Edit
One active session per account (Account Already Active prompt, other device signed out), sign-in 429 fix, unified Publisher Edit, Received Reports and comparative report improvements

Received Reports Excel exports now include the Total and the end-of-report summary; Previous Manual Record: Excel-only full screen, verified comparative analysis with bar graphs, findings and optional free AI wording
Add and Edit Publisher: Province, Municipality, Barangay and Contact are now optional; a publisher can be saved without changing the username
Account Management is now one module: publishers, FS Group, status filter, Audit History, Create Account, View temporary sign-in. Circuit Overseer Accounts and User Management are reached from it.
New login screen. Account Management: type the temporary password yourself (or leave it empty for a random one), View temporary sign-in, one module for every account.
Previous Manual Record: download the uploaded Excel file with its original name. File Manager: PDF, Excel and Word only.

Back to Homepage on every main form. Signing in on a second device now needs the signed-in device to approve it (Yes, It's Me / No, Deny Access) or an e-mailed code. Favorites for Searching, Return Visit and Bible Study. Find Location can read coordinates from a picture. Long-press on the Territory Map no longer presses buttons by accident.

GoPreach v1.165.0: security and device management (two-factor, new-device approval, instant sign-out), Territory Map and Ministry full-screen forms, Field Service Report export menu and category choice, group chat roles.

GoPreach v1.166.0: account recovery for a lost password and authenticator (e-mail code, 24-hour wait, cancel), a phone whose session the server ended now returns to the login screen, Field Service Report export and category choice, security notification centre and history filters.
GoPreach v1.167.0: the approval prompt for a new device is back on the signed-in phone, a merged Devices list (rename or remove a device), account recovery, instant sign-out on all devices.
GoPreach v1.167.1: a closed Security Notice stays closed (and notices are marked seen on the server).
GoPreach v1.167.2: fixes the Security notice that could not be closed; checks for an update when the sign-in form shows.
GoPreach v1.168.0: Super Admin sign-in limits module
GoPreach v1.169.0: Driving Mode arrow in the lowest position and always facing forward; territory drawings show a finished / to continue / to do date, details inside the drawing
Ministry: Recycle Bin shows only deleted records and they can be restored; sort by name A-Z or Z-A; consistent colour codes under each record; Place of Origin is no longer required when enrolling.
FS Group chat: the Group Overseer, Servant and Assistant can create, rename and delete chats of their own FS Group. The monthly report shows the publisher name.
Group chat: a Delete button in the chat's top bar for the Group Overseer, Servant and Assistant (and chat managers).
Group chat: removed the Open the chat button that brought a deleted FS Group chat back.
GoPreach v1.169.5: the navigation arrow and camera follow the road; walking has its own turn warnings and off-route tolerance; current speed shown; optional own routing server
GoPreach v1.169.6: Print button on every Ministry record; first build signed with the GoPreach production key (uninstall the old app once, then install this one)

GoPreach v1.169.7: no square lines inside barangay boundaries and drawings; Draw button on the Territory Map; the arrow stays on the road in Drive and Walk without a destination; clearer reinstall notice when an update uses a new signing key

GoPreach v1.169.8: Congregation Management for the Circuit Overseer; send photos in Group Chat (gallery or camera, optimized, full-screen view); Back to Home on every form; redesigned long-press menu; flat Ministry tabs and toolbar; arrow in the lower middle of the screen with only the remaining route; fingerprint login kept after sign-out
v1.169.9: fixes missing barangay boundaries on the Territory Map after a fresh sign-in

GoPreach v1.169.16: the Admin can enroll a Publisher without the full address, contact, province, municipality and barangay; a person's own profile requires them; the Coordinate is one box (Latitude, Longitude); Publisher name search in more lists; Field Service Report exports named with the group and month; Publisher edit finds records with an empty congregation; My Report hides hours for non-pioneers; the update notice is not repeated for an acknowledged version.

GoPreach v1.169.17: Meeting and Cart Assignment now picks publishers from a checkbox list with search, Select All, Clear Selection and a count; the Admin can enroll a Publisher without the contact details and a person completes them in their own profile; the Coordinate is one box (Latitude, Longitude).

GoPreach v1.169.18: the Midweek Meeting Schedule is laid out like the printed sheet (congregation and title, week, coloured bars, numbered parts with minutes, names in a column on the right) on screen and when printed; publishers are chosen in a popup checklist (search, Select All, Clear, count) opened from a Select publishers button, no longer inside a text box.

GoPreach v1.169.19: the week of the Midweek Meeting is shown as < November 2-8, 2026 > with arrows instead of a drop-down; the Admin and the Super Admin can set the language of the three Midweek headings to English, Tagalog or Iloko; the Midweek Meeting Schedule is laid out like the printed sheet and publishers are chosen in a popup checklist.

GoPreach v1.169.20: Meeting and Cart Assignment now has two modules, the Congregation and the Sign Language Group, each with Midweek Meeting, Public Talk and Watchtower and Cart Assignment and the same rules; the heading language is set per module; the week is shown as < November 2-8, 2026 >.
Username-first login; PIN, Pattern and Biometrics sign-in and Session Expired on the website
Remember me fills the password after the remembered username; Return Visit / Bible Study quantities can be typed in My Planner; login methods listed only when available and set up

- You can now put an update off with UPDATE LATER; GoPreach reminds you again the next time you log in.
- The update notice shows what is new in each version.
- The login screen no longer lets the phone's autofill offer your saved username and password.
- Return Visit and Bible Study quantities can be typed in My Planner.
- Remember me fills the password only after you type the remembered username.

- The username must match exactly, capital letters included, before Remember me fills in the password.
- The Lost your authenticator link is no longer on the login screen.
- The Return Visit and Bible Study quantity in My Planner can now be left empty and still be saved.
- The login screen no longer shows the keyboard's key icon with your saved username and password when you tap the username or password box.
- Month selection is now < Month > with arrows instead of a dropdown list (Monthly Report, comparisons, snapshots and more).

- Territory Map: the screen stays on while you choose a route and while navigating.
- Territory Map: Start navigation is always reachable; the route panel scrolls and the button stays pinned.
- Long-press menu: Actions (Draw, Create a Pin, Start navigation, Walk there) now come before Map tools.
- Update dialog: scrolls for long notes, shows the release date and cleaner What's new details.
Find Location is now Capture Coordinate: a search box at the top of My Planner
Fixed the Ministry search box; Territory Map search now lists all matching Searching, Return Visit and Bible Study records
Territory Map search now finds every record of the congregation, including other FS Groups and publishers
Territory Map: new All option; Nearest and Farthest are dropdown lists under every option; search follows the chosen option

- The update notice now lists every change since your installed version, newest first, each under its own version and date.
- Territory Map: new All option, and Nearest / Farthest are dropdown lists under every option.
- Territory Map search finds every record of the congregation and follows the chosen option.
- Fixed the Ministry search box disappearing while typing.

Capture Coordinate shows which record a saved coordinate is enrolled to, with Add Visit Log or View Record. Territory Map has a My / FS Group / Congregation dropdown under Searching, Return Visit and Bible Study.
The update window now always shows what is new in the update. If a release has no details, it says bug fixes and improvements.
Territory Map filters are tidier: one row for All, Searching, Return Visit and Bible Study, a single My / FS Group / Congregation dropdown, and Nearest and Farthest side by side.

- The update window now shows the specific changes of every release since your installed version, not just 'bug fixes and improvements'. The details load from a source that also works on networks that block GitHub's API.
- Main Form tabs are now equal in size and perfectly aligned: icons, labels and underlines line up on every tab.

- New: when you enroll a Searching, Return Visit or Bible Study record, the app warns you if the same person may already exist (similar name plus the same or a nearby location), and lets you view the existing record, use it, or continue.
- Street View now finds the nearest street photo (up to about 1.3 km) and offers Google Street View when there are none nearby.

- Ministry tabs (Searching, Return Visit, Bible Study) are tidier: Add on its own row, then Export, A-Z, Favorites and Recycle Bin as four equal buttons.
- Street View now opens Google Street View directly.

- New History tab in the Ministry: every enrolment, visit log, move, assignment, location and edit, with its date and details when you tap it.
- New Ministry Recycle Bin: deleted and inactive Searching, Return Visit and Bible Study records, with filters, Restore and Delete Permanently.
- Duplicate person warning now also works for records that have no saved location.
- Update window lists every change since your installed version, loaded from GoPreach's own server.
- Login can use your device screen lock (PIN, pattern or password) when there is no fingerprint or face.

- The Ministry Recycle Bin is tidier: the record type is one row, the other filters are folded under More filters, and Restore and Delete Permanently sit side by side on every record.
- The website can now set up a PIN, a Pattern and Device Unlock (fingerprint, face or screen lock) from the Security page, and offers it after sign-in.

- The Delete and Delete Permanently buttons are now solid red with white text, so they can be read. This covers the Ministry Recycle Bin and the Territory Map delete buttons.
- Restore and Delete Permanently in the Ministry Recycle Bin use the same buttons as the rest of the app.
Sign-in fixes: PIN and Pattern login on the website no longer hits 'too many requests', and a drawn pattern now matches reliably. Bug fixes and improvements.
New: Territory Map work reminders. When a To Do or To Continue drawing of your FS Group is dated tomorrow or today, you get a notification (with a sound) when you sign in. Bug fixes and improvements.

Territory Map fix: if your FS Group was not found from your role (for example a Group Overseer, Servant or Assistant), the map now finds it from the group itself and shows your territory. Bug fixes and improvements.

Capture Coordinate now reads the picture with the AI reader: it fills in the name and any written coordinates, then Enroll opens with the name, coordinate, Province, Municipality and Barangay filled and the duplicate check on. Notes on Searching, Return Visit and Bible Study records is now a list (CA, NH, RV, B, C, MO, LP, NT, BS). Bug fixes and improvements.

Capture Coordinate: a saved location that a Searching, Return Visit or Bible Study record now uses leaves the Saved Locations list (it stays under Already used by a record for viewing) and returns when its last record is deleted. The name in a captured picture is now read by the same text reader as the coordinates, with the AI reader preferred when available. Bug fixes and improvements.
Names are now always upper case: in the Capture Coordinate picture dialog and on new records. Bug fixes and improvements.
Planner: Hours, Minutes and the Hours Goal can now be typed directly in the field, not only with the plus and minus buttons. Bug fixes and improvements.

Sign-in fix: your username no longer has to match capital letters exactly (a phone keyboard that capitalizes the first letter no longer causes 'Invalid username or password'), and the username and password boxes no longer auto-capitalize.

Fixes and additions: a Super Admin who signs in on a phone another account used now sees every congregation's publishers (Central Congregation Solano showed 0); signing in as a different person clears the previous account's data on the phone; the Ministry Recycle Bin shows only your own deleted Searching, Return Visit and Bible Study records; admins see whether each publisher's temporary password is unused, used (change due), changed or disabled, and can filter publishers by it; a temporary password is now visible only to the Super Admin and the congregation Admin.

Account Management now shows each account's password step (temporary password not used yet, used with the change due, changed, or disabled) with a filter and a Password column; the View temporary sign-in option appears only for the Super Admin and the congregation Admin.
Account Management now shows 'requests for new sign-in details' (people who tapped Forgot Password) with a Mark as done button, and the Super Admin can filter accounts by role, like the website.

Publishers (Super Admin and Admin) now look like the website: a search box that is always there, the Field Service Group and Filter choices, List View / Table View / Full Screen / Excel buttons, a teal print button, larger rounded cards with Details, edit and more-actions, a chip showing each publisher's temporary-password step, and a green Add Publisher button.

Full Screen on record lists (Publishers, Account Management and the other modules that have it) is now a true full screen: the status and navigation bars hide too, and an Exit Full Screen button stays on screen so you can always come back.

Territory Map: if your FS Group's territories are missing on the phone but show on the website, the app now downloads them again automatically the first time you open the map, so your territory appears.
